fields.System.Title: INB-209 — Confirm idempotently so retries are safe
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk on unreliable warehouse wifi, I want tapping confirm twice to be
harmless, so that a lost response does not double the stock.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a confirm request with an idempotency key, when the same key is sent again,
  • then no new stock is created and the original response is returned.
  • - Given two identical confirm requests sent concurrently, then exactly one is
  • processed.
  • - Given the idempotency key, then it is enforced by a unique database constraint, not by
  • a check-then-insert.
  • - Given a different key with the same content, then it is treated as a new request — the
  • key is the client's declaration of intent.
  • - Given a stored key, then it expires after a configured retention period.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, platform |
| Tables | idempotency keys, receipt |
| Risks | Duplicate stock from a retry ([doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | idempotency (sequential and concurrent — mandatory) |
